adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework repaired the missing activity/toxicity rows, re-adjudicated DBAASP database conflicts, checked the OA supplement PDF for additional activity material, and replaced framework-test placeholders with paper-specific worker-6 adjudication. The paper is publication-grade accepted_with_cautions with no open rework targets.
summary: Tables 3-4 now provide 28 source-backed activity/toxicity rows; linked DBAASP conflicts are preserved; no direct antimicrobial mechanism is overclaimed.

caution_findings.finding: Table 3 renders the Mtb strain as H73Rv, while the section prose, methods, and narrative interpretation identify H37Rv; final rows use H37Rv and preserve this as a caution.
DBAASPS_21403/Hirsutellide 11 database activity rows are not source-verified because they carry compound 9-like values and an M. vaccae row absent from Table 4 compound 11.
The source paper labels the cytotoxicity assay Hep2G, while linked DBAASP rows use HepG2; final activity rows follow the paper label and database audits preserve the target-label conflict.

OA package supplement ao0c01065_si_001.pdf was text-indexed and checked for activity/MIC/IC50 terms; it contains synthetic, spectral, HRMS, and UPLC-MS material rather than additional activity/toxicity tables.
The paper supports phenotypic SAR/activity and ADME context, but not a direct antimicrobial mechanism; final mechanism ontology avoids direct-mechanism overclaim.
